notebooks.title: 路径扰动与边界复算
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
import sympy as sp
from scipy.integrate import solve_ivp, quad

cells.code:
t,e=sp.symbols('t e',real=True)
y=t+e*sp.sin(sp.pi*t)
F=sp.simplify(sp.integrate(sp.diff(y,t)**2/2,(t,0,1)))
print('端点:',y.subs(t,0),y.subs(t,1))
print('正泛函/负泛函:',F,-F)
print('第一/第二变分:',sp.diff(F,e).subs(e,0),sp.diff(F,e,2))
print('自由终点零路径目标:',sp.integrate(sp.Integer(0),(t,0,1)))
print('匀速系数:',sp.solve([sp.Symbol('b'),sp.Symbol('a')+sp.Symbol('b')-1],[sp.Symbol('a'),sp.Symbol('b')]))

notebooks.title: Bellman符号倒推
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
import sympy as sp
from scipy.integrate import solve_ivp, quad

cells.code:
q,r,p=sp.symbols('q r p',positive=True)
x,u=sp.symbols('x u',real=True)
B=(q*x*x+r*u*u+p*(x+u)**2)/2
us=sp.solve(sp.diff(B,u),u)[0]
print('最优动作:',us,'二阶导:',sp.diff(B,u,2))
print('P递推:',sp.factor(2*B.subs(u,us)/x**2))
P=[sp.Integer(0)]*3;P[2]=sp.Integer(1);K=[0,0]
for k in [1,0]:
    K[k]=P[k+1]/(1+P[k+1]);P[k]=1+P[k+1]/(1+P[k+1])
print('P:',P,'K:',K,'V0(2):',P[0]*4/2)
print('无状态/终端惩罚P:',[0,0,0])

notebooks.title: 整段二次问题独立核验
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
import sympy as sp
from scipy.integrate import solve_ivp, quad

cells.code:
a,b=sp.symbols('a b',real=True);x0=sp.Integer(2);x1=x0+a;x2=x1+b
J=(x0*x0+a*a+x1*x1+b*b+x2*x2)/2
sol=sp.solve([sp.diff(J,a),sp.diff(J,b)],[a,b]);print('软终端动作/状态/目标:',sol,x1.subs(sol),x2.subs(sol),J.subs(sol))
print('阶段与终端:',(x0*x0+a*a).subs(sol)/2,(x1*x1+b*b).subs(sol)/2,x2.subs(sol)**2/2)
H=sp.hessian(J,(a,b));print('Hessian:',H,'顺序主子式:',H[0,0],H.det())
hard=J.subs(b,-x0-a);ah=sp.solve(sp.diff(hard,a),a)[0]
print('硬终端动作/中间状态/目标:',ah,-x0-ah,x0+ah,hard.subs(a,ah))
print('零状态最优目标:',sp.Integer(0))

notebooks.title: 协态与Bellman核对
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
import sympy as sp
from scipy.integrate import solve_ivp, quad

cells.code:
xs=[sp.Integer(2),sp.Rational(4,5),sp.Rational(2,5)]
P=[sp.Rational(8,5),sp.Rational(3,2),sp.Integer(1)];us=[-sp.Rational(6,5),-sp.Rational(2,5)]
ps=[P[k]*xs[k] for k in range(3)]
print('协态:',ps)
print('协态递推残差:',[ps[k]-xs[k]-ps[k+1] for k in range(2)])
print('动作驻点残差:',[us[k]+ps[k+1] for k in range(2)])
print('Bellman残差:',[P[k]*xs[k]**2/2-(xs[k]**2+us[k]**2)/2-P[k+1]*xs[k+1]**2/2 for k in range(2)])
print('终端残差:',ps[-1]-xs[-1])

notebooks.title: 连续时间Riccati与代价
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
import sympy as sp
from scipy.integrate import solve_ivp, quad

cells.code:
t=sp.symbols('t',real=True)
x=2*sp.exp(-t);u=-x
stage=sp.integrate((x*x+u*u)/2,(t,0,1));terminal=x.subs(t,1)**2/2
print('连续阶段/终端/总:',stage,terminal,sp.simplify(stage+terminal))
print('连续终点:',x.subs(t,1),float(x.subs(t,1)))
def rhs(t,y):return [y[0]**2-1]
for s0 in [1.,0.]:
    sol=solve_ivp(rhs,[1.,0.],[s0],rtol=1e-11,atol=1e-13,dense_output=True)
    p=float(sol.y[0,-1]);print('s/P0/J0:',s0,p,2*p)
    print('终端/方程复核:',sol.sol(1.)[0],p-(1 if s0==1 else np.tanh(1)))
print('s0解析值:',2*np.tanh(1))
print('协态/驻点/状态残差:',sp.simplify(sp.diff(x,t)+x),sp.simplify(u+x),sp.simplify(sp.diff(x,t)-u))
print('quad积分证书:',quad(lambda z:4*np.exp(-2*z),0,1)[0]+2*np.exp(-2))

notebooks.title: 六题答案复算
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
import sympy as sp
from scipy.integrate import solve_ivp, quad

cells.code:
t,e=sp.symbols('t e',real=True)
f=sp.simplify(sp.integrate(sp.diff(t+e*sp.sin(sp.pi*t),t)**2/2,(t,0,1)))
print('题1泛函/一阶:',f,sp.diff(f,e).subs(e,0))
P=[sp.Rational(8,5),sp.Rational(3,2),sp.Integer(1)];xs=[sp.Integer(2),sp.Rational(4,5),sp.Rational(2,5)];us=[-sp.Rational(6,5),-sp.Rational(2,5)]
print('题3 P/K/V:',P,[sp.Rational(3,5),sp.Rational(1,2)],P[0]*xs[0]**2/2)
print('题4阶段/终端/总:',[(xs[k]**2+us[k]**2)/2 for k in range(2)],xs[-1]**2/2,P[0]*xs[0]**2/2)
print('题5协态:',[P[k]*xs[k] for k in range(3)])
print('题6阶段/终端/总:',2*(1-sp.exp(-2)),2*sp.exp(-2),sp.Integer(2))
